description:
modules/parentbilling — GET /traeger/care-tariffs (#4684): the Träger
binding of the Träger transaction, the schools of the Träger
(Organisation & Tenancy), the contract versions in force of the year
before and of the year after the current month (Betreuungsvertrag, one
statement each), the prices and the last billed month per school. Flat in
the number of schools, contracts and prices.
